name: Macropod
oneLiner: AUDM is Macropod's centralized Australian dollar stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 by approved clients and backed by AUD cash held in trust at a Big 4 Australian bank.
collateral: Australian dollar cash held 1:1 in segregated AUDM Trust accounts at a regulated Big 4 Australian ADI (National Australia Bank per public reporting); reserves are not lent, invested, or rehypothecated
pegMechanism: Approved Macropod clients deposit AUD into the reserve to mint AUDM and return AUDM to Macropod for 1:1 AUD redemption by bank transfer, subject to onboarding, KYC/AML, sanctions, and compliance checks

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Macropod describes AUDM as an issuer-backed Australian dollar token and announced direct deployment on Base after earlier Ethereum, Solana, and Redbelly support. No third-party bridge dependency was resolved, so the route is reviewed as issuer-native multichain issuance.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: centralized governance metadata indicates issuer or admin control; registry links were reviewed for direct freeze, blacklist, pause, burn, or upgrade authority.

reserves.name: AUD cash held in segregated AUDM Trust account at a Big 4 Australian bank (NAB per public reporting)

slices.name: AUD cash held in segregated AUDM Trust account at a Big 4 Australian bank (NAB per public reporting)

mintAuthority.summary: AUDM is issued by Macropod (AFSL 566313, AUSTRAC DCE100887005-001); approved clients deposit AUD into the AUDM Trust reserve to mint and return AUDM for 1:1 redemption, all gated through the issuer's compliance/onboarding backend.

controls.label: Macropod issuance backend
controls.evidence: Issuer-operated mint/redeem: Macropod mints AUDM against AUD deposited into the AUDM Trust reserve by KYC/AML-approved clients and redeems 1:1; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists.

controls.label: AUDM DEFAULT_ADMIN (Ethereum + Base)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295029 and Base block 47200702, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x999071576cc6d7feadb908bede992ab9e19212cf) returned true on the AUDM ERC1967 proxy (impl: ERC20FGasless). eth_getCode returns no bytecode → EOA. Confirmed via RoleGranted event in creation tx (Ethereum: 0x744699f5..., Base creation logs match).

controls.label: AUDM MINTER_ROLE holder (Ethereum + Base)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295029 and Base block 47200702, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE=0x9f2df0..., 0x3529a9f8193cce36df81123b59cdb4250219db39) returned true. eth_getCode returns no bytecode → EOA. This address has executed mint() calls (0x40c10f19) on Ethereum.

controls.label: AUDM Solana mint authority (EOA wallet)
controls.evidence: Solana getAccountInfo (jsonParsed) for SPL mint CiYXBwHPrdNkMtxR8YEWKv78K6bQjFoEWhPQrZqEmubi returned mintAuthority = BS6KEeboF6Z2yDbxa8FD6UmPvorWwpm4QviYdpNpdAEQ. Confirmed EOA: account owned by System Program (11111...), executable=false, zero data.

review.evidence: Macropod docs describe a single regulated issuer minting AUDM against custodied AUD reserves, with client onboarding/KYC gating; mint/redeem is centralized. Ethereum and Base EVM chains confirmed: DEFAULT_ADMIN = EOA 0x9990..., MINTER_ROLE = EOA 0x3529... (both verified via hasRole at blocks 25295029/47200702). Solana SPL mint CiYXBw... confirmed: mintAuthority = EOA wallet BS6KEebo... (System Program owned, not executable). Redbelly uses same contract address as Ethereum (0x0815...cbdd) — same admin as Ethereum by deployment construction (note-only per brief; not independently queried).
